item.title: Learning Curve
item.description: There is a learning curve in kayak fishing, starting with the basics like where to keep your paddle and how to handle a fish from the kayak. Over time, as you practice things like tying knots and fishing the same lure in your favorite spot, the curve begins to flatten out and success becomes more consistent. The post Learning Curve first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.

item.title: The World’s Largest Arapaima Fishing Farm!
item.description: This video shows Jurassic Jewels, the largest Arapaima farm in North America! We were incredibly lucky to get up close with these monster fish—right here in Florida! Not only did we get an exclusive tour, but we also got the chance to fish a few of the ponds ourselves and it did not disappoint! From giant strikes to unforgettable catches, this was an adventure you won’t forget. The post The World’s Largest Arapaima Fishing Farm! first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.

item.title: Fish School – Spotted Sea Trout
item.description: Spotted sea trout are better known as speckled trout, and when they get really big, gator trout. Regardless of what you call it, it’s not a trout at all. Specks belong to the drum family. They are one of the most targeted species in their range which extends from Texas to Maryland. The post Fish School – Spotted Sea Trout first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.

item.description: New spotted seatrout regulations have been approved for the Indian River Lagoon, bringing stricter seasons and harvest limits aimed at protecting one of the region’s most popular inshore species. item.title: Florida Freeze Triggers Widespread Snook Kill, Raising Concerns for Inshore Fisheries
item.description: A recent Florida freeze has triggered widespread snook mortality, with anglers reporting dead and cold-stunned fish across inshore waters. Biologists are still assessing the full impact on snook populations. The post Florida Freeze Triggers Widespread Snook Kill, Raising Concerns for Inshore Fisheries first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.
